method: read-only (?mode=ro) inspection of plain-root production DB; no copy mutation

existing_table_row_counts.note: Plain-root prod DB carries full V49 schema but zero Phase 10 candidate rows; the dev scheduler writes the (Dev) root. Lifecycle behavior is validated via pytest fixtures and synthetic rows seeded into the /tmp copy.

cross_family_gap_analysis.candidate_review_events_scope: task|commitment only (candidate_type); no subject_type taxonomy for daily_brief_action / accepted_task / accepted_commitment / follow_up_watch

migration_decision.rationale: Existing tables cannot represent cross-family lifecycle (merge across arbitrary subjects, group-key suppression, close/reopen across daily-brief/accepted/watch) idempotently. candidate_review_events is task/commitment-only and lacks target/group/effective-until fields.
migration_decision.guard_columns: 13 Phase 10 guard columns with CHECK(=0) on each new table
migration_decision.materialized_queue_rationale: Review queue is a computed read model over candidate/domain tables + lifecycle overlay; no persisted queue required per review_queue_contract.

raw_safety.fields: table/column names, counts, version numbers, reason codes only
